pitch: cmux-sentinel is an opinionated custom sidebar for cmux — a clean, monospace, Ayu-Mirage workspaces list with live per-agent row states and pluggable AI usage meters (Claude, Codex, Command Code, Amp) shown as native progress bars with compact countdowns.
challenge: cmux custom sidebars are sandboxed: they can only read a fixed set of per-workspace fields and can't fetch URLs or read arbitrary data. So live agent state is smuggled through STATIC title markers — reference-counted so co-tenant agents don't stomp each other or strand a dead session — and usage meters are fed by background launchd pollers that write into the same narrow channel.
